title: SYN-DIGITS: A Synthetic Control Framework for Calibrated Digital Twin Simulation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the systematic statistical bias and miscalibration of LLM-generated digital twins by comparing their simulated survey responses (e.g., MovieLens ratings, Twin-2K-500 behavioral surveys, and OpinionQA answers) against ground-truth human response distributions using individual-level correlation metrics (Pearson correlation) and population-level divergence metrics (Total Variation, KL divergence, Hellinger distance).
